decisions.reason: The multi-model enclosed laser workstation line extends the firm's core laser competence to manual and small-batch marking, and a growing firm has no reason to withdraw it after two years.
The thermal inkjet printer is a standard part of a single-source coding portfolio and generates recurring consumables revenue.
The piezo inkjet printer complements the thermal model for industrial inks and difficult surfaces, which fits the firm's strategy of matching technology to each surface.
The flagship laser marking line is featured on the home page and is central to the firm's direction, so withdrawing it is very unlikely.
The newly launched compact laser cabin has its own page and rounds out the laser portfolio alongside the flagship systems.
The award-winning lubricant printing system serves a distinct sheet-metal niche that builds on the firm's inkjet expertise, so it should be retained.
